claim.quote: A non-monotonic energy dependence of the ratio of K^+ to pi^+ yields is observed, with a maximum close to 40 AGeV

name: NA49 energy dependence of pion and kaon production in central Pb+Pb collisions

summary.plain: NA49 compared charged pion and kaon production in central lead-lead collisions at 40, 80 and 158 GeV per nucleon with results at other energies, finding a non-monotonic energy dependence of the kaon-to-pion ratio with a maximum close to 40 GeV per nucleon.
summary.technical: Charged pion and kaon production in central Pb+Pb at 40, 80 and 158 AGeV: mean pion multiplicity per wounded nucleon rises approximately linearly with s_NN^1/4 with a change of slope in the 15-40 AGeV region; pion suppression turns into enhancement near 40 AGeV; K+/pi+ shows a maximum close to 40 AGeV.

title: Energy Dependence of Pion and Kaon Production in Central Pb+Pb Collisions
why_it_matters: First report of the 'horn' in the K+/pi+ ratio that later became a key signature of the onset of deconfinement.
